verdict.rationale: Phaser Editor ships an MCP Server with over 40 specialised tools that plugs into Claude Desktop, Cursor and GitHub Copilot. The editor page says it can create a particle emitter, reorganise a scene into layers and rename objects, so an agent can drive the editor's scenes and objects programmatically. The hosted Phaser Game Agent MCP adds a documented plain-language route for agents to build games. Missing for 10: evidence that agents can trigger builds or publishing through the interface, a documented tool/API reference for scene, node and property operations, and independent hands-on corroboration.
